newsitem.title: USA: Meadowbrook eyes options, cites losses.
newsitem.headline: Meadowbrook eyes options, cites losses.

text.p: Meadowbrook Rehabilitation Group Inc said Monday that continuing losses have caused to company to explore alternatives, including a merger or putting itself up for sale.
"As a result of the company's continued losses, the board of directors is in the process of evaluating the company's strategic direction and alternatives.

"The alternatives under consideration by the board include, among other things, a merger or other business combination transaction or sales of assets," President and Chief Executive Officer Harvey Glasser said in a statement accompanying the announcement.
Meadowbrook reported a net loss Monday of $590,000,or $0.31 per share, for the fiscal year ended June 30.
Fiscal 1996 net operating revenues were $23,623,000, 18 percent higher than 1995's net operating revenues of $19,974,000 and net loss of $3,529,000, or $1.82 per share.

Despite increased net revenues, the company said its net loss was largely a result of operating losses incurred in the first year of operating the Colorado clinics, as well as decreased patient census and revenue per patient day in the company's acute, subacute and post-acute facilities.
